cases.question: How does login work for an existing user?
cases.section: 2. Complete Authentication Workflow Map; Screen 2: Login & Sign-Up Screen
expected_source_evidence: The passenger's registered name is automatically fetched and placed into the name field.
The name input is automatically locked (non-editable)
The returning passenger can now choose whichever method they prefer: either request an OTP or immediately log in using their 4-digit PIN.

cases.question: What happens for a first-time user?
cases.section: Screen 2: Login & Sign-Up Screen; Screen 4: Mandatory PIN Setup Screen
expected_source_evidence: The name field remains blank and editable.
The user is required to enter their full name
Only the "Get OTP" button is displayed.

cases.question: How does OTP verification work?
expected_source_evidence: Validates passenger identity via a 4-digit SMS code

cases.question: What is the PIN lockout behavior?
expected_source_evidence: Configurable max failed attempts (default 3) and lockout duration (default 5 minutes).
3 wrong attempts triggers a live countdown lockout timer stored persistently on device.
